newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia consumer prices seen down 0.2 pct in Aug.
newsitem.headline: Russia consumer prices seen down 0.2 pct in Aug.

text.p: Russian consumer prices fell 0.1 percent in the week ended August 26, the same fall as in the previous week, the State Statistics Committee said on Wednesday.
If present trends continue, prices will fall 0.2 percent over the whole of August, it said in a statement.
This would be the first fall in monthly prices since economic reforms started in 1992.
Monthly inflation in July was at a post-reform low of 0.7 percent.
If current trends continue, the price rise over the whole of 1996 will be 16 percent, the committee said.
RUSSIAN CONSUMER PRICES w/e Aug 26 w/e Aug 19
The fall in prices so far in August was due to a fall in food prices. Prices for non-food goods and for services have continued to rise slightly.
